reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Wyoming
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Are eviction cases first heard in county court?
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ----------------------------- */

% We encode the question's factual statement as a claim about the forum.
% The statement to test: "eviction cases are first heard in county court".
scenario_claim(first_heard_in, eviction_case, county_court).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded question statement is present.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_claim(first_heard_in, eviction_case, county_court).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute encoding (deterministic)
   ----------------------------- */

% WY Stat  1-21-1001 (2021) - Jurisdiction of circuit courts.
% "Any circuit court ... may inquire against those who make unlawful and forcible entry ...
% and detain ... or ... having a lawful and peaceable entry ... unlawfully ... hold the same."
%
% We encode this as: circuit courts have jurisdiction over forcible entry and detainer matters,
% which are a core category of eviction proceedings.
statute_wy_1_21_1001_court_with_jurisdiction(circuit_court, forcible_entry_and_detainer) :- !.

% Map the scenario category "eviction_case" to the statute's covered category.
% This is the legal characterization step: eviction cases (as asked generally) include
% forcible entry and detainer/unlawful detainer proceedings described in  1-21-1001.
legal_characterization(eviction_case, forcible_entry_and_detainer) :- !.

/* -----------------------------
   Reasoning helpers
   ----------------------------- */

% Determine which court the statute assigns as the proper hearing court for the category.
proper_hearing_court_for_category(Category, Court) :-
    legal_characterization(Category, StatuteCategory),
    statute_wy_1_21_1001_court_with_jurisdiction(Court, StatuteCategory),
    !.

% For this question we treat "first heard" as the initial forum with jurisdiction
% under the provided statute(s).
first_heard_in(Category, Court) :-
    proper_hearing_court_for_category(Category, Court),
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Final answer (must be yes/no, deterministic)
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_claim(first_heard_in, Category, ClaimedCourt),
    first_heard_in(Category, ClaimedCourt),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in county court?
